description: Create and analyse customer feedback surveys for an authorised business Team in full MCP clients. Supports satisfaction, matrix, NPS, and free-text questions; email preview; selected recipients or all Team members; response statistics; status updates; and confirmed deletion or email delivery. Sending email and deleting a survey require explicit user confirmation. This tool is excluded from the OpenAI review profile.

audience.description: send_survey: selected addresses or every active/invited Team member

brand_name.description: create/update: brand shown in the invitation and survey

confirm.description: Required true for delete_survey and send_survey, only after explicit user confirmation

questions.description: create/update: full question list; defaults to satisfaction, matrix, NPS, and comments

survey_id.description: Required except for list_surveys and create_survey

team_id.description: Business Team ID returned by manage_business_teams action=list_teams

title.description: create/update: customer-facing survey title and email subject

name: manage_feedback_surveys
